section.title: Research translated into systems
section.intro: Current and recent projects across wearable AI, generative modeling, multimodal learning, clinical language systems, and perceptual computer vision.

items.title: Gated CNN for watch-based fall detection
items.subtitle: Efficient temporal modeling without attention
items.description: A gated convolutional approach for smartwatch fall detection that learns relevant temporal features without computationally expensive attention mechanisms, supporting efficient deployment.

items.title: MA-RAG
items.subtitle: Multi-agent RAG for longitudinal clinical assessment summarization
items.description: A multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation system for query-driven interpretation and structured summarization of longitudinal clinical assessment reports.

items.title: Physics-informed digital twins for motion
items.subtitle: Risky-posture, gait, and balance simulation
items.description: A research direction centered on digital twins of human motion, combining multimodal sensing, latent generative models, and physical constraints to study gait, balance, workplace posture, and fall risk.

items.title: Synthetic wearable fall data
items.subtitle: LLMs and diffusion models for scarce-event learning
items.description: An investigation of whether generative models and large language models can produce wearable time-series signals that are useful for downstream fall detection.
